name: Research Projects
description: Research is a process of enquiry and investigation with the goal to solve a practical problem or to uncover new knowledge. To master the skills in conducting original and independent research is the most important training in postgraduate studies. This course provides a learning platform for new research students before embarking on their own research project. Through guided research projects, students will learn the characteristics of a good research work, practice critical review, explore creativity, learn to be resourceful and how to effectively communicate the research findings.
